description: Search published EvalGate documentation by keyword. Use it first when you have a question or topic but no page slug. Returns up to 10 ranked matches with slug, title, URL and summary; read a match in full with docs_get.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return, from 1 to 10; defaults to 10.

query.description: Keywords or a short question, e.g. 'regression gate' or 'how do API keys work'.

name: docs_search
